name: Fjord Explorer
included: 3 nights in 3-star hotels with breakfast, the Flåm Railway, a 2-hour fjord cruise on the Nærøyfjord, all train and bus transfers from Bergen
dates: Weekly departures every Thursday: 13 May to 23 September 2027
desc: A classic first trip to Norway. Ride the Flåm Railway down from the mountains, cruise the narrow Nærøyfjord between steep green walls, and spend a night in the village of Flåm. Calm, scenic and easy, with short walks only.

name: Northern Lights Week
included: 5 nights in Tromsø with breakfast, three evening aurora chases by minibus with warm clothing, one day of whale watching (November to January) or snowshoeing (February to March)
not_included: Flights to Tromsø, lunches and dinners, travel insurance
dates: Departures every Monday: 1 November 2027 to 27 March 2028
desc: Six winter days above the Arctic Circle. Three guided evening chases follow the clearest sky to give you the best chance of seeing the northern lights. Days are short and cold, nights are long and magical.

name: Lofoten Light
included: 4 nights in traditional fishermen's cabins (rorbuer) with breakfast, a guided hike to Reinebringen, a sea kayak trip, a car ferry pass
not_included: Flights to Bodø, dinners, travel insurance
dates: Departures every Saturday: 5 June to 21 August 2027
desc: Sharp peaks rising straight from the sea, white beaches and red fishing cabins, all under the midnight sun. Hike, kayak and taste fresh cod in small fishing villages.

name: Bergen City Break
included: 2 nights in a central hotel with breakfast, a guided walk through Bryggen, a return ticket on the Fløibanen funicular, the Bergen Card for 48 hours
dates: Start any day of the year
desc: Colourful wooden houses at Bryggen, the fish market, and the view from Mount Fløyen. A relaxed self-guided city break with one guided walk. Breakfast is included every morning.

name: Oslo Food and Culture
included: 2 nights in a design hotel in Grünerløkka with breakfast, a guided food walk with 6 tastings, a ticket to the National Museum, an evening at a jazz bar
desc: Oslo's food halls, coffee bars and new Nordic restaurants, plus the opera house roof, the National Museum and lively nightlife in Grünerløkka. Perfect for food lovers and city people.

name: Geiranger Cruise and Hike
included: 3 nights (Ålesund and Geiranger) with breakfast, a fjord cruise past the Seven Sisters waterfall, a guided hike to the Skageflå farm, bus from Ålesund
dates: Departures every Tuesday: 18 May to 14 September 2027
desc: The famous Geirangerfjord, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Cruise past waterfalls, then hike up to an old mountain farm with a view over the whole fjord.

name: Mountain Cabin Retreat
included: 4 nights in a private mountain cabin with all meals, two guided day walks, a lake canoe, bus from Oslo
dates: Departures every Sunday: 13 June to 12 September 2027
desc: A quiet nature holiday in Norway's highest mountains. No crowds, no traffic: just lakes, glaciers on the horizon, home-cooked meals and long light evenings.

name: Trolltunga Challenge
included: 2 nights in Odda with breakfast and packed lunch, a certified mountain guide for the 10 to 12 hour Trolltunga hike, transfers from Bergen
dates: Departures every Wednesday: 16 June to 15 September 2027
desc: One of the most famous hikes in the world: 27 kilometres return to the rock that sticks out 700 metres above the lake. For fit hikers only.

name: Svalbard Arctic Expedition
included: 6 nights in Longyearbyen with breakfast, a 2-day boat expedition to glaciers and the ghost town of Pyramiden, a guided walk with an armed guide, all safety equipment
not_included: Flights to Longyearbyen, most dinners, travel insurance
dates: Departures every second Monday: 12 April to 23 August 2027
desc: The high Arctic, halfway between mainland Norway and the North Pole. Glaciers, walruses, reindeer and, with luck, a polar bear seen safely from the boat.

name: Norway in a Nutshell Classic
included: 1 night in Flåm with breakfast, the Bergen Railway, the Flåm Railway, a fjord cruise and the bus over Stalheimskleiva, all tickets in one pack
dates: Start any day of the year (winter timetable from November to April)
desc: The quickest way to see the best of western Norway: train, fjord boat and bus from Oslo to Bergen in two days. Self-guided, with all tickets arranged.

name: Stavanger and Preikestolen
included: 2 nights in Stavanger with breakfast, a guided hike to Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock), a Lysefjord cruise
dates: Departures every Saturday: 3 April to 23 October 2027
desc: Hike to Pulpit Rock, a flat cliff 604 metres above the Lysefjord, then see it from below on a fjord cruise. Evenings in Stavanger's old town.

name: Winter Husky Adventure
included: 3 nights in a wilderness lodge with all meals, a full day driving your own husky team, one night in a heated lavvu tent, an aurora evening
dates: Departures every Thursday: 2 December 2027 to 23 March 2028
desc: Drive your own team of huskies across the snowy plateau of Finnmark, sleep in a Sami-style tent and look for the northern lights. Cold, wild and unforgettable.
